sn45.28:1.2: Ariyaṃ vo bhikkhave sammāsamādhiṃ desissāmi saupanisaṃ saparikkhāraṃ ||
sn45.28:1.4: Katamo ca bhikkhave ariyo sammāsamādhi sa upaniso saparikkhāro ||
sn45.28:1.6: Yā kho bhikkhave imehi sattahaṅgehi cittassa ekaggatā saparikkhārā ||
sn45.28:1.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyo sammāsamādhi saupaniso iti pi || saparikkhāro iti pī ti || || 1.2.
